text.p: Healthdyne Technologies Inc said Thursday that new production introductions should boost its earnings by the second half of 1997.

Healthdyne President and Chief Executive Craig Reynolds said in a statement that the company is wrapping up a transition period, resulting in a shift of its product mix designed to make it more cost-effective.
"During the year, we have signed several licensing agreements with high technology companies for products that are designed for the emerging subacute and home care markets," Reynolds said.
"These products together with a number of internally developed products are scheduled for introduction over the next 18 months," he added.
In addition, Healthdyne recently introduced a non-invasive ventilator, called Quantum, which surpassed $9 million in sales in its first 12 months on the market.
The company said the product introductions were expected to improve its earnings beginning in the second half of 1997.
